input_contract.assembly: human reference genome; exact GRCh38 provenance not independently verified

score_contract.score_semantics: masked-language-model logits/embeddings; no official raw SNV VEP contract verified

provenance.notes: Official repository and checkpoint were audited and the pinned checkpoint passed both the Phase 5 synthetic plumbing smoke and a Phase6A tiny real-GRCh38 embedding-throughput smoke. Caduceus-Ph is a 131,072-bp masked-language model trained with reverse-complement augmentation. Phase6A used four SHA-256-selected locked-cohort variants, 8192-bp reference/alternate forward and reverse views, mean-token pooling, finite [16, 256] pooled outputs, and no feature-cache write; the best warm throughput was 19.8545 variants/s at variant batch size 1 over four variants. No raw allele-effect VEP API was verified, so a pseudo-likelihood adapter would not be apples-to-apples with Evo2. This remains SUBSET_ONLY for embeddings/logits, not included in the raw-score benchmark. Evidence: artifacts/model_audit/phase5_real_smokes_20260921.json and artifacts/phase6a/phase6a_representation_throughput_20260921.json.
